# instrument_golden_v1.txt — instrument-mode transcripts pinned at revision
# 3926110 (pre-WP-1.4), so that WP-1.4's play-mode movetime mechanism can be
# shown to leave instrument behavior byte-identical, permanently, not only in
# the session that landed it.
#
# Generated at revision 3926110 in a clean git worktree (`git worktree add
# <dir> 3926110; cargo build --release --locked`), by running the `pistol`
# binary at configs/gate_v0.toml over every position of the sha-pinned tactical
# fixture (crates/pistol-cli/tests/fixtures/tactical_v0.txt), `newgame` before
# each `go`, budgets depth_turns 3 and nodes 50000, and stripping the two
# machine-measuring fields (` nps <n> time <n>`) exactly as tools/determinism.sh
# does. The worktree output was diffed against an independent capture from the
# live tree at the same revision: identical.
#
# Budgets are depth_turns 3 + nodes 50000 rather than the determinism gate's
# depth_turns 4 + nodes 200000 because the gate budgets cost ~35 s release and
# many minutes debug per `cargo test`, which CI's test gate cannot afford; the
# reduced budgets run the same paths (the deepening loop, the transposition
# table, the interrupted-iteration path via the node budget) over ALL twenty
# positions. The full gate-budget pre/post comparison was run once in the
# WP-1.4 session and is cited in its report and ADR line.
#
# Grammar: `case`, then a `position` protocol line, `budget <kind> <amount>`,
# and the expected answer lines as `expect <line>` (per-depth `info` lines, the
# `info totals` line, then `bestmove`). Every field except the stripped two is
# reproducible on every machine (CLAUDE.md rule 4, docs/decisions.md D-7).
# This file is sha-pinned by the test that reads it (docs/decisions.md D-37).
# Regenerating it requires a superseding ADR line naming the new revision.
case
position set p1:0,0 1,0 2,0 3,0 4,0 p2:-1,0 1,3 2,3 3,3 1,5 2,5 tomove:p1 phase:0
budget depth_turns 3
expect info depth_turns 1 seldepth 1 nodes 1 hashfull 0 score mate 1 pv 5,0
expect info totals depth_turns 1 seldepth 1 nodes 1 hashfull 0 score mate 1 pv 5,0
expect bestmove 5,0
case
position set p1:0,0 0,1 0,2 0,3 0,4 p2:0,-1 2,0 3,0 4,0 2,2 3,2 tomove:p1 phase:0
budget depth_turns 3
expect info depth_turns 1 seldepth 1 nodes 1 hashfull 0 score mate 1 pv 0,5
expect info totals depth_turns 1 seldepth 1 nodes 1 hashfull 0 score mate 1 pv 0,5
expect bestmove 0,5
